blocks.orig: The Lake Masek Tented Lodge is a lodge with luxury safari tents right in the middle of Ndutu – the area just south of Serengeti National Park that is famous as the area where the calving season of the Great Migration takes place. Each of the 30 tents is set up on a wooden platform with an ensuite bathroom with both a bath and an outside shower. A private terrace allows you to observe a multitude of wildlife drinking at the lake. The beautiful main building of the lodge is made of wood and a thatched roof and hosts a lounge, a restaurant where meals are served, as well as a terrace with a pool and spectacular views of the lake.
blocks.html: The Lake Masek Tented Lodge offers luxury safari tents in the very heart of Ndutu, the area just south of Serengeti National Park that is known for hosting the calving season of the Great Migration. All 30 tents stand on a wooden platform and have an ensuite bathroom with a bath as well as an outdoor shower. From your private terrace you can watch a wide variety of wildlife coming to drink at the lake. The lodge's attractive main building, built from wood with a thatched roof, houses a lounge and a restaurant where meals are served, plus a terrace with a pool and spectacular lake views.
